content: As illustrated in Figure 3 , the question generation model contains an encoder and a decoder. We use a hierarchical encoder consisting of two layers to model the meaning of each element (subject, predicate or object) and the relationship between them. Since each element might contain multiple words, we use RNN as the word layer encoder to get the representation of each element. We define the fact level sequence as a path starting from the anchor and ending at the candidate answer. Another RNN is used as the fact level encoder. The last hidden state at the fact layer is fed to the decoder.
